title: Bills, Receipts, Invoices and Vouchers
introduction: Explore bills, receipts, invoices and vouchers using everyday examples.
definition: A bill states an amount due, an invoice requests payment for goods or services, a receipt records payment, and a voucher may provide a specified reduction. Read quantities, prices, totals and amounts paid.

examples.question: An invoice lists 3 books at RM12 and delivery RM4.

exercises.question: 4 items at RM8 each. Invoice subtotal?
RM50 bill, RM5 voucher. Amount due?
RM80 paid on a RM100 invoice. Balance?
Receipt shows RM25 and RM15. Total?
RM60 purchase with RM10 voucher and RM50 payment. Balance?
Which document records payment: invoice or receipt?

summary: A bill states an amount due, an invoice requests payment for goods or services, a receipt records payment, and a voucher may provide a specified reduction. Read quantities, prices, totals and amounts paid.
